name: website-deploy
description: Deploy static websites to simple-host.app from your coding agent (inline JSON or tar.gz/zip). Each site gets a per-site backend (shared JSON state with atomic ops, append-only collections), built-in server-side visitor analytics, and can be connected to your own custom domain — subdomain via CNAME or apex via A record. Reads of the backend are public; a page can save only on a site with its own domain, where visitors sign in with Google or an emailed code via the hosted auth.js; agents write with an API key anywhere. Bundles a builder skill (plan what to build) and a connect-domain skill.
